verdict.rationale: mise lets users define tasks with dependencies that run in parallel, and `mise watch` re-runs them automatically when files change. It also runs those tasks non-interactively in CI via mise-action or a committed wrapper, and the MCP server lets an AI assistant run mise tasks. However, these are triggered or watcher-driven task runs rather than true autonomous background automation. missing for 10: scheduled/cron-style triggers, a background daemon or agent that runs automations unattended, documentation of background execution and monitoring, independent hands-on corroboration.
